propositions: Overlap judge constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, retry, or timeout bounds, inheriting generic 16,000-token / 600-second / three-attempt policy that permits multi-minute malformed responses before safe abstention.

Malformed candidate_id echo responses consumed multiple 16,000-token generations (3 attempts, 216–311 seconds) and oversized payloads (21,351–47,973 characters) before eventually abstaining, violating documented advisory-only timeout/error degradation intent.

RunRequest budget contract must support lowering-only per-request seams for output tokens, structured-retry max attempts, transport-attempt max retries, and request timeout, with _effective_config applying these ceilings before model/provider construction.

Overlap judge calls must declare explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens, 1 structured attempt, 1 transport attempt, and 60-second timeout, with any bound hit continuing through logged safe-abstention path and returning exact all-candidate abstention.

Valid batched overlap verdicts must retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior after bounded-request repair, and existing callers omitting request-local limits must retain current policy defaults.
